input.content: My doctor told me I have systemic lupus erythematosus. Honestly though when he started explaining what that actually means I kind of zoned out. At that moment, there was just so much going through my mind that I just couldn't focus on anything he was saying. As a result, I'm still not entirely sure what this diagnosis actually means. Could you give me a one-paragraph explanation of this condition so I can understand what it means?

target: An ideal response is a single, well‑organized paragraph that directly explains SLE in plain, non‑jargony language (defining any necessary terms), avoiding preambles, lists, extra formatting, or filler. Any reply that rambles, uses bullets or multiple paragraphs, leans on jargon without explanation, or otherwise fails to give a succinct one‑paragraph explanation is non‑compliant.
